subject: Stage-gate prepay and credit band structuring for Lumina Health
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@luminahealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage-gate prepay and credit band structuring for Lumina Health

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks for the chat yesterday. Per our discussion, Lumina’s preference is Net60 across the board; we wanted to put a pragmatic option on the table that balances your cashflow needs with Redwood’s credit exposure while keeping VAT handling clean.

Attached: proposed-payment-structure.xlsx and Lumina_SOW_v2.pdf for context. High-level proposal follows:

Option A — Net60 (standard requested) with credit-band guardrails
- Trial credit cap: $100,000 for first 90 days
- Auto-increase to $250,000 after successful usage review (SLAs, abuse, consumption patterns)
- Monthly invoicing in arrears; payments due 60 days from invoice date
- Redwood reserves right to require a deposit or switch to staged prepay if usage outpaces credit band by >20%

Option B — Stage-gate prepay (preferred compromise)
- 30% prepay of forecasted 3-month run-rate (applied as credit against invoices)
- Remaining billing monthly in arrears, Net45 after the prepay clears
- Prepay refundable against usage in 30/60/90-day stage gates if thresholds not met

VAT / tax handling notes:
- If invoices are billed to an EU/UK entity of Lumina and you provide VAT registration evidence, we can issue invoices net of VAT and rely on reverse-charge where applicable.
- If billing to a US entity, Redwood will charge VAT where required and include VAT on the invoice.

Ask: please confirm which legal entity Lumina will route POs to and whether you can provide VAT registration/evidence. Also let us know which option (A or B) is acceptable in principle — if neither, propose an alternative and we’ll circle back.

Next steps:
- If you pick Option B, we’ll prepare a short amendment (DocuSign) to add a prepay schedule and credit-band matrix.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Jordan Blake
Principal, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-payment-structure.xlsx (spreadsheet), Lumina_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@luminahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@luminahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Stage-gate prepay and credit band structuring for Lumina Health

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear options. A couple of quick clarifications from procurement / finance:
1) Lumina’s preference remains Net45 if possible; Net60 creates forecasting headwinds for us.
2) For Option B, would Redwood consider 20% prepay instead of 30% (our cash desk is stretched in Q2)?
3) On VAT: we prefer to route invoices to our UK subsidiary (Lumina Health UK Ltd) and apply reverse-charge; I’ll attach our VAT cert and a short note from tax (see Lumina_Tax_Coverage.docx).

If you can meet Net45 with a 20% prepay and keep the $100k trial cap, we can move quickly. We’ll need the amendment in DocuSign and confirmation that the prepay will be applied as credit (not a non-refundable fee).

— Asha Menon
Head of Procurement | Lumina Health
asha.menon@luminahealth.com

Attachment: Lumina_Tax_Coverage.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@luminahealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate prepay and credit band structuring for Lumina Health

Asha / Tom —

Appreciate the prompt reply and for sending the VAT cert. Quick commercial reply from Redwood Finance: we can accept the Net45 ask contingent on the following balanced mitigations:

1) Prepay reduced to 20% of the 3-month forecast (Redwood applies as credit to invoices; fully refundable if consumption is materially below forecast at the 90-day review).
2) Trial credit cap remains $100k for first 90 days; once usage patterns are stable and we see predictable consumption, cap increases to $250k.
3) If actual consumption exceeds forecast by >25% in any monthly period, Redwood will require an interim top-up (applied as credit) or move the account to a staged billing cadence for the remainder of the quarter.
4) VAT: since Lumina will route invoices to Lumina Health UK Ltd and you provided VAT registration, Redwood will issue invoices net of VAT and include the reverse-charge note; we do not need to register in the UK for this engagement. Please send the full PO referencing deal LUM-2027-044 to procurement@redwood.com.

I’ve attached a short credit-band matrix that maps usage tiers to cap increases and required prepay triggers.

If that sounds OK I’ll have legal draft a one-page amendment (DocuSign) that adds: (a) Net45 payment term, (b) 20% prepay schedule, (c) credit-band cap & review cadence, (d) clause for interim top-up on >25% overspend. We will mark the prepay as customer credit on Redwood invoices (not a fee).

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: credit-band-matrix.pdf

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@luminahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@luminahealth.com>, procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:21:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Stage-gate prepay and credit band structuring for Lumina Health

Kimberly / Jordan —

This looks good to us. We can route POs to Lumina Health UK Ltd and apply reverse-charge. Confirming Lumina is comfortable with:
- Net45 term
- 20% prepay applied as credit
- $100k initial trial cap with automatic review at 90 days

Two asks from Lumina finance:
1) Can Redwood schedule invoices on the 1st of each month (we prefer consistent payment dates)?
2) Please send the DocuSign amendment; we’ll aim for a 30-day pilot post-signature (so we can validate run-rate before increasing the cap).

Thanks — I’ll loop procurement on the PO once we have the DocuSign.

Tom Reynolds
VP Partnerships | Lumina Health
tom.reynolds@luminahealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@luminahealth.com>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate prepay and credit band structuring for Lumina Health

Tom / Asha —

Thanks — great, we’re aligned. Action items and timeline: 
- Redwood legal will circulate a 1-page amendment (DocuSign) by EOD Monday; DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/amendment/LUM-044 (also attached as amendment-docusign-link.txt).
- Lumina to issue PO to Lumina Health UK Ltd and send copy to procurement@redwood.com once signed.
- Invoices scheduled on the 1st of each month; Net45 terms apply.
- 20% prepay credited to the account on Day 0 and applied against invoices; 90-day review to consider cap increase.

If anything changes on your side, flag to me and Kimberly. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the amendment and PO path. Looking forward to running this pilot with you.

Best,
Jordan
